_doc: Shared defaults plus per-agent variation. This file is the ONLY place a per-agent clause may live. It is rendered into all harness files for that agent, never hand-written into one of them.

defaults.lead_tail: All identity, voice, rules and tools load from a single manifest.
defaults.boot_tail: It lists every file to load at boot, in order, plus the on-demand tiers.
defaults.query_scope: about the project, a past decision, or another agent's context
defaults.tail_line: Everything else (memory, domain notes, catalogs) is **read on demand**, not at boot. The manifest explains the triggers.

capability_line.template: Before answering anything substantive ({scope}), query the knowledge service: {call}. Never bulk-scan the notes folder.

shared_tail: > **Rules** - the {{measured.rules}} project rules live in `rules/`. They bind every harness equally.

**This file is machine-generated** by `{{generator}}` from `registry.json` + `agents.json`. All {{harness_count}} siblings ({{siblings}}) carry a byte-identical body apart from three registry-driven lines. **Do not hand-edit**: a hand edit is drift and `--check` fails on it. Put doctrine in the boot manifest.

reviewer.tail_line: Everything else (review checklists, past findings) is **read on demand**, not at boot.
clauses: Review notes are private to this agent by default. Never surface them to other agents without the owner's direction.

shared-notes._note: A real manifest, not a pointer: it keeps its own body verbatim and holds all siblings byte-identical with ZERO varying lines.
